summary.headline: Dhruv Consultancy Q1 FY27 net sales fell to INR15.55 crore with an operating loss of about INR3 crore, while Q1 order inflow reached about INR90-100 crore.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 net sales were INR15.55 crore and total income INR15.95 crore, with management attributing the operating loss to estimate corrections, tax reversals and a fixed-cost base ahead of revenue conversion. Management said Q1 order inflow was about INR90-100 crore, including a INR40.92 crore OBCC order, the largest ticket the company has booked. Unexecuted order book is stated at INR300 crore, with the company also citing a total order book of INR600 crore in a later answer. Management guided that billing on new orders starts around Q3 and that the company is entering wayside amenities through a 55% SPV. Management gave no numeric FY27 guidance, citing SEBI LODR constraints.

segments.name: Infrastructure consultancy (PMC, authority engineer, independent engineering, DPR/lender engineering)
segments.commentary: Q1 orders of about INR90 crore included INR19.34 crore Rowghat-Jagdalpur railway authority engineer and PMC work (140 km), INR8.34 crore MPRDC Ujjain-Jaora IE, and INR40.92 crore from OBCC. Company is executing 65-70 assignments.

segments.name: Wayside Amenities (new vertical)
segments.commentary: Formed SPV Verul Drivehub Private Limited with 55% stake; first 15-year lease-based development and O&M agreement signed 4 August 2026, with revenue expected from around February 2027. Three further LOAs expected in September 2026.

guidance_outlook: No numeric FY27 revenue or profit guidance given; management cited SEBI LODR restrictions.
Management expects Q3 and Q4 to be stronger than Q1 and Q2 as billing on new orders starts, with billing expected around Q3.
Management said bids are being submitted at better margins; the company has no specific margin target.
Management targets 10-15% of order book from international markets (Ghana preferred bidder, Mozambique empanelment, Saudi Arabia bids).
Wayside Amenities: first site revenue expected around February 2027, 7-8 months after possession for subsequent projects.
capex_capacity: Railway project (Rowghat-Jagdalpur) requires 108 manpower; management said about 60-70% already deployed and project commencement expected in about a month.
Company is building AI dashboards to track 65-70 assignments and aims to handle around 120 assignments a year.
Head office staff of about 80-85 are receiving monthly project-management training; BIM training underway (currently 3D, aiming for 6D).
Wayside Amenities site: fuel pump installation (4-5 months) is the critical path; sites are 50-60% constructed by NHAI and concessionaires.
demand_pricing: Q1 order inflow of about INR90-100 crore, compared with about INR90-100 crore for full FY26 per management.
Q2 to date additional orders of about INR60-65 crore cited.
Average ticket size has risen from INR5 crore to INR10 crore to INR20-40 crore; minimum ticket of recent LOAs cited as about INR8 crore.
Assam Brahmaputra 6 km bridge: company is H1 with bid of INR33 crore against competitor bids of INR12, INR13 and INR20 crore (LOA pending).
Company rated 9th among about 100 consultants by NHAI; management said the new rating framework gives technical scores more weight.
Lender's engineer fees cited at about INR2 lakh per month in India vs INR4-5 lakh per month internationally.

qa_highlights.question: What FY27 revenue guidance can the company achieve given Q1 income of about INR16 crore and new mandates?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined numeric guidance citing SEBI LODR; said Q1 and Q2 typically make up 30-40% of annual revenue and Q3-Q4 are higher due to monsoon and award timing.

qa_highlights.question: What share of Q1 orders will convert to FY27 revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about 15-20% of the order book converts to revenue annually; based on INR250-300 crore unexecuted book, around INR200 crore is expected over two years.

qa_highlights.question: Why is Q1 operating margin negative and when will it recover?
qa_highlights.answer: Management called the loss largely a paper loss from estimate corrections after NHAI removed network survey vehicle scope; said the correction was about INR30-35 crore (under 5% of order book), and margins should improve as billing starts in Q3.

qa_highlights.question: When will Wayside Amenities contribute revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: First site possession given 4 August 2026; fuel pump installation takes 4-5 months and revenue is expected from around February 2027.

qa_highlights.question: What is the receivable cycle?
qa_highlights.answer: Typically 60-90 days; up to 120 days in Northeast or difficult-access states.

qa_highlights.question: Will new orders be billed in H1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said billing on new assignments starts after two quarters, with Q3 and Q4 expected to be better on margins.

risks_watch: Operating loss of about INR3 crore and negative operating margin in Q1; watch whether Q2 and Q3 billing turns margins positive as management expects.
High fixed employee cost (about INR15 crore in Q1) relative to revenue; new railway hiring of about 100 staff adds to costs.
Management's inconsistent order-book figures (INR250 crore, INR300 crore, INR360 crore, INR600 crore) need reconciliation.
International conversion is slow (Ghana contract conversion takes 4-6 months); Middle East war has caused some bids to be missed.
Client policy changes (NHAI removing network survey vehicle scope) led to a scope reduction and estimate correction.
Q2 FY27 order inflow of about INR60-65 crore to be confirmed; Wayside LOAs expected in September 2026.
summary.management_tone: Confident on order wins and long-term positioning, but evasive on quantitative guidance (citing SEBI LODR) and on the cause and timing of the Q1 loss. Management attributed the loss to estimate correction and cost absorption, and said Q3 should improve.
key_quotes: So this is a paper loss, what is the INR3 crores or INR4 crores what is there in Q1.
So the principal issue in Q1 is if you can see the operating leverage, our technical and project delivery it is a combination of fixed cost and variable cost.
So these billing is expected to start somewhere in Q3.
So it's difficult for me to give any numbers as the SEBI LODR doesn't allow us to do that.

Rowghat-Jagdalpur railway authority engineer and PMC project, 108 manpower deployment (60-70% already deployed)

growth.why: No numeric FY27 guidance (SEBI LODR cited), but management expects Q3 and Q4 stronger than Q1-Q2 as billing on Q1 orders of about INR90-100 crore starts, and Wayside revenue begins around February 2027; Q1 sales of INR15.55 crore are still loss-making, so the outlook is positive but not quantified.
